_about: Entries whose identifier was trained on (part of) this benchmark's files — their score is partly accuracy on training data. Keys are entry-name prefixes; counts are of this benchmark's 3,404 files, by git blob id. A value is either a text (the whole benchmark is that entry's home turf) or {"why", "cases_tag" or "cases"}: only those cases are; the overall leaderboard then counts the entry, held out, on the other cases.
